items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Frank Skinner and guys like that used to write these arrangements

ctx.x: -- over the years. How do you view this?

Well, at the time, of course, when I first come into music, I was right on the end of Dixieland, the Dixieland craze, going into swing. And that's when guys like Archie Blyer and -- they used to write, Frank Skinner and guys like that used to write these arrangements, 'Business in F' and 'Business in Q' and all of that. That was just the beginning of the swing era.
